ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: There is evidence that low self-esteem people are less evaluatively consistent in their self-descriptions. When Campbell and Fehr examined how subjects rated themselves on sets of adjectives that were either uniformly positive or uniformly negative, subjects with low self-esteem not only gave ratings that were (on average) less positive or more negative, but their ratings within each set exhibited more individual scatter or greater variance. High self-esteem subjects strongly and consistently endorsed the positive adjectives and rejected the negative adjectives. Low self-esteem subjects did not, in contrast, strongly and consistently endorse the negative adjectives and reject the positive adjectives. Rather, they gave more intermediate ratings and more variable ratings to both types of adjectives. Therefore, it appears that low and high self-esteem individuals differ not only in the average positivity of their self-views, but also in the extent to which their self-views are evaluatively consistent with one another.

High self-esteem subjects strongly and consistently ③<u>endorsed</u> the positive adjectives and rejected the negative adjectives. Low self-esteem subjects did not, in contrast, strongly and consistently endorse the negative adjectives and reject the positive adjectives. Rather, they gave more intermediate ratings and more variable ratings to both types of adjectives. Therefore, it ④<u>appears</u> that low and high self-esteem individuals differ not only in the average positivity of their self-views, but also in the extent to which their self-views are evaluatively consistent with one another.

✅ ① consistent: 'less evaluatively consistent'에서 형용사 보어로 올바른 어법

✅ ③ endorsed: 'strongly and consistently endorsed the positive adjectives'에서 과거시제 동사로 올바른 어법

✅ ① evidence(증거): '낮은 자존감 사람들이 덜 일관적이라는 증거(evidence)가 있다'는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② scatter(산포, 분산): '더 많은 개별적 산포(scatter)를 보였다'는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ rejected(거부했다): '부정적 형용사를 거부했다(rejected)'는 문맥에 적절
❌ ④ extreme → intermediate: 'they gave more extreme ratings'에서 원문은 중간적인(intermediate) 평가. extreme(극단적인)으로 바꾸면 낮은 자존감이 극단적 반응을 보인다는 의미가 되어 본문 논지와 정반대 ←정답
det.tip: 낮은 자존감 사람들은 극단적(extreme)이 아니라 중간적인(intermediate) 평가를 합니다. 이는 높은 자존감의 일관된 긍정/부정과 대조됩니다.
